title: Hunts FH-028S: Walk a real operator through the partner agreement and get sign-off
detail: Done when a real operator can explain who owns claims, prize stock, cancellations and support per venue, and the partnerships owner, finance (FH-035) and counsel have approved the terms in docs/hunts/PARTNER-AGREEMENT.md. Open questions are listed at the bottom of that doc. Requires FH-027 and the owner. Hunts switches stay OFF.
